en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning reissued until 11:30 am
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a fresh Thunderstorm Warning at 10:20 a.m., expecting isolated squally thunderstorms over the territory.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a Thunderstorm Warning at 10:20 a.m. on Tuesday, stating it would remain valid until 11:30 a.m. Isolated squally thunderstorms were expected over Hong Kong.

An earlier Thunderstorm Warning issued at 2:33 a.m. had been cancelled at 8:30 a.m. The Observatory advised people outdoors to seek safe shelter, leave the water and keep away from highly conductive objects, trees or masts when thunderstorms occur.

A special weather tip earlier in the day noted that Tropical Storm Narra was expected to stay a considerable distance from Hong Kong while active south to southwest winds continued to bring showers and thunderstorms.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告再發至上午11時30分
zh.dek: 天文台上午10時20分再發雷暴警告，預料本港有局部地區狂風雷暴。
body: 香港天文台今日上午10時20分發出雷暴警告，有效至上午11時30分，預料本港有局部地區狂風雷暴。
較早前於凌晨2時33分發出的雷暴警告已於早上8時30分取消。天文台提醒市民，戶外人士應尋找安全的地方躲避，離開水面，並遠離導電物體、樹木或桅杆。
天文台早前特別天氣提示指出，熱帶風暴紫檀預料與本港保持相當距離，活躍的偏南氣流則繼續為本港帶來驟雨及雷暴。
